notes: Source = H.R. 7008 Engrossed-in-House (EH) text, 14768 chars, read in full. Two operative sections: SEC. 2 adds Subchapter IV (13151-13153) to chapter 131 of title 5 (congressional stock-trading restrictions on Members + spouses + dependent children, fee = greater of $2,000/10% + net gain, divestiture, DOJ referral for non-payment, 180-day effective date); SEC. 3 adds HAVA section 303A photo-ID requirement for in-person and non-in-person federal-election voting plus conforming amendments to HAVA 311(b) and 401 (90-day effective date). Every substantive operative claim is source-supported; ZERO material errors, zero direction inversions, zero figure/attribution errors. Minor items: top-line drops the "to the extent practicable" hedge on the copying-device duty and "District of residence" from the excepted-fund exclusion; brief/summary say "mail voters"/"dependents" where source says "other than in person"/"dependent child". Two minor coverage omissions (13153(f) interpretative guidance; 303A(a)(1)(B)(ii) savings clause). likelihoodReason sponsor/cosponsor/Senate-procedure claims are structural cache metadata / general procedure, not in bill text (acceptable framing per rubric class 8). featured_quotes (Perry P000605, Miller M001211, Krishnamoorthi K000391, Lawler L000599) could NOT be audited: the Congressional Record floor statements are not in this bill-text source and no referencedSources were registered — no quote rows created. No divisions[] (not an omnibus).
